title: Exploring Sequence Feature Alignment for Domain Adaptive Detection Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2107.12636v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Detection transformers have recently shown promising object detection results and attracted increasing attention. However, how to develop effective domain adaptation techniques to improve its cross-domain performance remains unexplored and unclear. In this paper, we delve into this topic and empirically find that direct feature distribution alignment on the CNN backbone only brings limited improvements, as it does not guarantee domain-invariant sequence features in the transformer for prediction. To address this issue, we propose a novel Sequence Feature Alignment (SFA) method that is specially designed for the adaptation of detection transformers. Technically, SFA consists of a domain query-based feature alignment (DQFA) module and a token-wise feature alignment (TDA) module. In DQFA, a novel domain query is used to aggregate and align global context from the token sequence of both domains. DQFA reduces the domain discrepancy

translated_title: 探索用于域自适应检测Transformer的序列特征对齐
translated_abstract: 检测Transformer近年来展现出了有前景的目标检测结果，并吸引了越来越多的关注。然而，如何开发有效的域自适应技术来提升其跨域性能仍未被探索且不明确。在本文中，我们深入研究了这一主题，并通过实验发现，仅在CNN骨干网络上进行直接的特征分布对齐只能带来有限的改进，因为它无法保证Transformer中用于预测的序列特征具有域不变性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的序列特征对齐（SFA）方法，该方法专为检测Transformer的自适应而设计。在技术上，SFA由一个基于域查询的特征对齐（DQFA）模块和一个逐词元特征对齐（TDA）模块组成。在DQFA中，一种新颖的域查询被用来从两个域的词元序列中聚合和对齐全局上下文，DQFA减小了域差异。
tldr: 提出了一种专为检测Transformer设计的序列特征对齐（SFA）方法，通过基于域查询的特征对齐（DQFA）模块和逐词元特征对齐（TDA）模块来减小域差异，从而有效提升跨域目标检测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel Sequence Feature Alignment (SFA) method specifically designed for detection transformers, which consists of a domain query-based feature alignment (DQFA) module and a token-wise feature alignment (TDA) module to reduce domain discrepancy and effectively improve cross-domain object detection performance.
